from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor

# Synthetic dataset (note: includes protected attribute only for auditing, not training)
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
n = 2000
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "region": rng.choice(["N", "S", "E", "W"], size=n),
    "marketing_spend": rng.normal(100, 20, size=n).clip(0),
    "price": rng.normal(10, 2, size=n).clip(1),
    # Protected attribute (kept ONLY to audit outcomes, not used as a feature)
    "protected_group": rng.choice(["A", "B"], size=n, p=[0.6, 0.4]),
})

# Target: demand (constructed without using protected_group)
noise = rng.normal(0, 5, size=n)

y_test = test_df["demand"]

# Preprocess + model
categorical = ["region"]
numeric = ["marketing_spend", "price"]

    transformers=[
        ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), categorical),
        ("num", "passthrough", numeric),
    ]
)

model = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=300, random_state=42)

pipe = Pipeline(steps=[("preprocess", preprocess), ("model", model)])
pipe.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict and evaluate

audit["y_pred"] = pred

    lambda g: np.mean(np.abs(g["y_true"] - g["y_pred"]))
)
